title: Track Delete Request
description: Describes an ongoing Track Delete Request

track_id.description: ID of the Track to which the delete request relates

timerange_to_delete.description: The timerange covered by the Track Events to be deleted in this request, as described by the [TimeRange](#/schemas/timerange) type. This property MUST only be present if all the Track Events (from the specified Track) that wholly overlap with this timerange are to be deleted in this request.

timerange_remaining.description: The timerange covered by the Track Events not yet deleted by this request, as described by the [TimeRange](#/schemas/timerange) type. This property MUST only be present if `timerange_to_delete` is also present.

delete_track.description: Indicates whether the Track itself is to be deleted after completing deletion of the selected Track Events.

created.description: Date/Time when this delete request was created

created_by.description: A string identifier for the entity that created the delete request. Service Implementations SHOULD set suitable default values for `created_by` based on the principal accessing the system.

updated.description: Date/Time when this delete request was updated

expiry.description: Date/Time when this delete request will be deleted

error.description: Provides more information for the error status, as described by the [Error](#/schemas/error) type
